description: Typography and layout fingerprints: em dashes, curly quotes, markdown tics, contractions.

features.explanation: Em-dash frequency, especially in rhetorical bridges ('— and this is critical —') where commas or parentheses would serve.
features.falsifiedBy: A calibrated baseline for this genre that places the observed value within one standard deviation of human reference prose.
